decisions.decision: Freeze UI architecture now; implement UI features in stages.
Traditional, Pradeep, and Technology are three independent selection systems; their screening standards must not be merged.
Pradeep Scanner is part of the Pradeep selection funnel; preserve the scanner architecture and do not treat old placeholder rules as authoritative executable rules.
Pradeep Phase 9 v1 source preparation is complete for the current point-in-time mission; do not reopen broad collection merely for continuous updates.
Technology is not built yet. Freeze only its architectural interface/position now; do not invent a Technology KB, scanner rules, or detailed tracking contract before the knowledge base exists.
Technology dynamic tracking uses the architectural pattern Recent Signal Cache -> Material Event Index -> Company State Timeline; do not store all raw real-time news permanently.
Static/versioned methodology knowledge and dynamic/current evidence are separate planes.
A unified candidate layer may aggregate outputs from independent systems while preserving why each system selected a company; no cross-system black-box total score is authorized.
